why: The yard declares its north side open as well as its other three — the side the far hall's arch, `edge/exit-arch`, is cut in. An open side stands no wall, so there is nothing to cut a portal in: the plan contradicts itself at the seam, and validation refuses it there, naming the edge, the face and the place, with the two repairs — declare the side `wall`, or make the crossing a `contact`. It declares no unit: every word it writes is bound on the site-plan point, and what must not validate is a door in a side with no wall.
